title: hosting.com Review 2026: A2 Hosting's New Name, Prices and AI Tools
excerpt: A hosting.com review from the host's own pages and one named independent test, covering the A2 rebrand, prices, AI tools and the Black Friday offer.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: hosting.com Review 2026: Prices, Speed, AI, A2 Rebrand
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: hosting.com review for 2026: A2 Hosting's new name, plan and renewal prices, a HostingAdvice speed test, AI tools, the Black Friday offer, pros and cons.
meta.rl_answer: hosting.com is A2 Hosting under a new name. It has the lowest sale prices here and a long AI list, but the renewal prices are high.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is hosting.com the same as A2 Hosting? | Yes. A2 Hosting announced on its own blog in April 2025 that it is now hosting.com.
Is hosting.com good? | HostingAdvice reported fast speeds and quick live chat replies. Renewal prices are among the highest it saw, so check them before you buy.
How much does hosting.com cost? | Starter is $1.49 a month, Pro $3.49 and Max $5.99 on 12-month plans. They renew at $13.99, $19.99 and $27.99 a month.
Does hosting.com have AI features? | It lists an AI assistant called Orbi, an AI website builder for WordPress and an MCP server. We did not test them.
Does hosting.com have a money-back guarantee? | It lists a 30-day money-back guarantee on its Black Friday page.
When does the hosting.com Black Friday offer end? | The page we read says 14 December 2026. Check the page before you buy.
